workflowNotes: Use the supplied GTA supplement alongside the official IMI agreement, not as a replacement or customised IMI form.
The supplement separates outstanding actions, owners, due dates and completion evidence from the gateway decision. Reuse the original SMART Action Plan when the gateway workflow is connected.
A discussion acknowledgement is not permission to submit. Gateway submission, tri-party signatures and EPAO acceptance must remain separate records.
Keep assessment-support information minimal; do not place sensitive medical or safeguarding narratives in the gateway record.
